Presenting ZINDAGI WO KYA NA PYAR JISME HO FULL VIDEO SONG from JAWAB movie starring Jeetendra, Leena Chandavarkar, Meena Kumari, Aruna Irani, Mehmood in lead roles, released in 1970. The song is sung by Lata Mangeshkar, Mohammed Rafi and music is given by Laxmikant-Pyarelal, music is available exclusively on Gaane Sune Ansune.
